services.name: Admission
services.desc: The Heritage Museum of Asian Art's Entrance is on West 35th Street. Take the elevator to the third floor and turn right to the Museum Reception Desk. Accessible and standard toilets are located on the same floor. Free parking space is available next to the museum via West 35th Street.​​ Heritage Museum of Asian Art is a non-profit organization with IRS 501 (c) (3) tax exempt

services.name: Becoming Words: Artist-Led Tour
services.desc: Join Japanese calligrapher Hekiun Oda and Iranian calligrapher and visual artist Bahman Panahi for an artist-led tour of Becoming Words. Explore how their distinct practices in Shodō and Nastaliq transform writing into movement, sound, abstraction, and shared experience. Join artists Hekiun Oda and Bahman Panahi for a guided tour of Becoming Words: A Joint Calligraphy Exhibition. Rooted respectively in the Japanese tradition of Shodō and the Persian tradition of Nastaliq, their practices approach calligraphy not simply as writing, but as a living, embodied art form.
